prompt_verbatim: Create ONE full-body pixel-art animation in-between of Ultraman Type C for a 2D side-view fighting game, head toward right. Reference 1 is the first touch of the monster's back; reference 2 is the later body-on-back pose. Draw the intermediate moment, NOT a duplicate of either: the hips remain near the first pose and sink a little, while the torso folds farther forward and the knees start lifting backward toward the later bent-leg pose. The upper abdomen is passively making contact with the back and begins bearing weight, not floating or deliberately flying. Both complete arms bend and stay tucked rearward alongside the ribs with hands clear of the abdomen contact area; the head and neck remain high enough to clear the rising horns. References 3 and 4 show the monster back and horn geometry ONLY: DO NOT draw the monster. Preserve reference 5 identity, short natural torso, red/silver suit, blue chest light, exactly two anatomically connected arms and legs. Full body within generously tall canvas, sharp coherent pixel art, genuinely transparent background, no ground, shadow, glow, text, grids, other figures or objects.
